name: CookTrace
description: CookTrace is a self-hosted recipe, pantry and cooking tracker. Keep a recipe library with cook mode, live scaling and a Nutrition Facts box, track your pantry with barcode scanning and expiration digests, plan meals on a calendar and log what you cooked, and build a shopping list from recipes, grouped by aisle. Import recipes from a URL or a file, or in bulk from Mealie, Paprika and Tandoor archives. Share cookbooks with other users or a whole household, log cooks to your NutriTrace diary, and use the native Android and Wear OS apps. Multi-user with OIDC single sign-on and scheduled backups. No telemetry and no accounts on external services; your data stays in your appdata folder. Before the first start, fill in JWT Secret with a long random string, for example the output of openssl rand -base64 48. Insecure Cookies starts at 1 so that signing in works over plain http:// on your LAN, which is how the WebUI link opens the app. Once the app sits behind an HTTPS reverse proxy, set it to 0.

paths.name: Database
paths.description: Folder for the SQLite database (cooktrace.db). Back up this folder and the Uploads folder.

paths.name: Uploads
paths.description: Folder for photos and other uploaded files.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the web interface. Change the host port if 3003 is already taken.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Required. Signs sign-in sessions and protects stored secrets. Use a long random string, for example the output of: openssl rand -base64 48. Keep it secret and keep it the same: changing it signs everyone out and makes stored sign-in and connection secrets unreadable.

variables.name: Insecure Cookies
variables.description: 1: sign-in works over plain http://, the way the WebUI link opens the app on your LAN. Session cookies then travel unencrypted, so keep the app on a network you trust. 0: session cookies are HTTPS-only. Use 0 behind an HTTPS reverse proxy; over plain http:// the browser drops them and signing in sends you back to the login page.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Optional. Serve the app under a subpath behind a reverse proxy, for example /cooktrace. Empty: served at the root.

variables.name: Recovery Token
variables.description: Optional. Turns on the lockout recovery option on the login page (Disable user management), which asks for this token. Empty: recovery stays off.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: How much the server logs. Default: info.

variables.name: Database File
variables.description: Database file inside the container. Leave as is: it sits in the Database folder above.

variables.name: Uploads Folder
variables.description: Uploads folder inside the container. Leave as is: it is the Uploads folder above.
